title: fix(metadata-protocol): draft-list unknown-package refusal names the package parameter
body:
Fixes #32109

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:草稿列表对未知包的拒绝文案,把"省略 packageId"改为"省略 `package`"。
- 为什么改:REST 查询参数已改名为 `?package=`,门会拒绝 `packageId`;原文案会引导作者写出被拒的参数。
- 风险与回滚:仅一句错误文案,无行为变化;revert 本 PR 即可。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts` 第 106 行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol-drafts-unknown-package.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The unknown-package refusal of `listDrafts` now ends ``omit `package` to list every package's drafts.`` instead of `omit packageId ...`. Landing point is the declared one, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts`; no other producer exists. Callers measured: the only door that reaches the sentence is `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts`; the client SDK `meta.listDrafts({ packageId })` option name is a TypeScript field, but it goes on the wire as `?package=` (client `index.ts`), so the sentence is true for every door that surfaces it. The sibling diagnostics refusal already says `omit package`.

## Tests

The existing unknown-package test now also asserts the new sentence is present and `omit packageId` is absent. `vitest run src/protocol-drafts-unknown-package.test.ts`: 5/5 passed. No other pin of the old text exists (`git grep "omit packageId"` outside CHANGELOGs: only the source line).

## Acceptance notes

None. Changeset: patch, `.changeset/32109-drafts-refusal-names-package.md`.

## Verification

Dependency closure built (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol^...`), then the test above under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0).
